subject: Error with categorical exogenous variables in structural model

messages.author: a8869489c6e79413
messages.subject: Error with categorical exogenous variables in structural model
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm working with lavaan to run the following model (N=: 

model <- '# MEASUREMENT MODEL
                F1 =~ x1 + x2
                F2 =~ x3 + x4
                F3 =~ x5 + x6 + x7
                F4 =~ x8 + x9
                F5 =~ x10 + x11
                F6 =~ x12 + x13
                F3 ~~ F4
                F7 =~ F1 + F2 + F3 + F4 + F5 + F6

                # STRUCTURAL MODEL
                outcome ~ F7 
                outcome ~ a*x14 + b*x15 + c1*x16_1 + c2*x16_2 + d*x17 + e1*x18_1 + e2*x18_2'

fit <- sem (model, data = data, estimator = "WLSMV", ordered=c("outcome", "x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9", "x10", "x11", "x12", "x13"))
summary (fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized = T)

The observed variables in the measurement model (x1-x13) are all ordinal, as well as variables x15-x18 (I recoded the ordinal ones to be dummies, that's why you see x16_1 and x16_2, for example). x14 is continuous. 

The measurement model runs smoothly and with an acceptable fit when performing a CFA (with an acceptable fit). And the structural model only regressing the higher-order latent factor F7 to the outcome also runs smoothly. However, when introducing the binary exogenous control variables to the model the following error appears:
